about_the_game:
In 'The Door Can't Be There!', you will play a character trapped in a mysterious space with the sole goal of solving one puzzle after another and finding the gateway to freedom. Each level is filled with hidden clues and props, and you must carefully observe the surrounding environment and use your intelligence to solve puzzles.

The game integrates a physics engine and complex puzzle design, allowing you to not only use your brain during the challenge, but also make quick decisions within a limited time. As the game progresses, you will unlock new props to help you stand out in more challenging levels.

The game 'The Door Can't Be There!' has multiple different scenes, suitable for players who enjoy puzzle solving and deduction games. If you enjoy challenging your intelligence, this game will be your best choice.
